label: Phosphate, vitamin D and biomineralization
reason: Vitamin D metabolism, Na/Pi cotransporters, FGF23-Klotho, PTH response and bone/tooth mineralization all serve mineral ion homeostasis.

label: Protein and lipid glycosylation
reason: N-/O-glycan synthesis, fucosylation, sialylation, blood-group antigens and CDGs; leukocyte rolling/HSC homing reflect selectin glycan ligands.

label: T cell integrin adhesion and immunological synapse
reason: Integrin activation, T cell polarity, synapse formation, raft localization and leukocyte migration form one lymphocyte adhesion theme.

label: Presynaptic vesicle exocytosis regulation
reason: Nearly all members regulate synaptic vesicle priming, fusion and Ca-dependent neurotransmitter release.

label: DNA repair and damage tolerance
reason: BER, NER, MMR, TLS, alkylation reversal, ICL repair and DNA demethylation via BER; a few replication/odd members are minor.

label: TLR/TNFR-driven NF-kB activation
reason: IKK recruitment, TAK1 activation, canonical and non-canonical NF-kB, TBK1/IRF3 and IKK deficiency diseases share one innate signalling axis.

label: Fibrinolysis and extracellular matrix proteolysis
reason: Plasminogen activation/fibrinolysis and MMP-mediated collagen/elastin degradation linked by the plasmin-MMP protease cascade and serpin control, plus integrin-ECM adhesion.

label: Monoamine neurotransmitter synthesis, signalling, reuptake
reason: Dopamine, noradrenaline and serotonin biosynthesis, receptors, transporters, MAO/COMT degradation and drug-reward behaviours.

label: Myeloid/erythroid/megakaryocyte haematopoietic differentiation
reason: RUNX1-driven programmes, granulopoiesis, erythropoiesis, megakaryopoiesis and progenitor BTMs all describe haematopoietic lineage commitment.

label: Eicosanoid and lipid-mediator inflammatory signalling
reason: Prostaglandin/leukotriene synthesis and receptors with endocannabinoid/DAG arachidonate release, plus histamine/P2Y inflammatory GPCRs; linked via arachidonate and inflammatory mediator GPCRs.

label: Viral life cycle and host interaction
reason: Entry, replication, translation, maturation and assembly of HIV, SARS-CoV, influenza, RSV, dengue, HCMV, plus host restriction.

label: Striated muscle growth, hypertrophy and adaptation
reason: Calcineurin-NFAT, cardiomyocyte proliferation/size, hypertrophy, atrophy and regeneration all concern muscle mass adaptation.

label: Chemokine-directed leukocyte chemotaxis
reason: Chemokine receptors, CXCR4/CCR7 signalling and DC, T, B, NK and mast cell chemotaxis form one migration theme.

label: T cell activation regulation and tolerance
reason: Treg differentiation, Th1/Th17 control, T cell proliferation/cytokine suppression and AICD all regulate T cell responses.

label: Potassium channels and resting membrane potential
reason: K2P, KATP and Ca-activated K+ channels and their diseases set membrane potential and K+ homeostasis.

label: Apoptosis and regulated necrosis
reason: BH3-only/BAX/BAK, apoptosome, caspase-8, TRAIL/Fas, necroptosis and DNA fragmentation; T cell signalling modules relate via AICD.

label: Glutamate receptor excitatory synaptic transmission
reason: AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptor trafficking, activation and plasticity (LTP) form one glutamatergic synapse theme.

label: Cerebellar development and motor behaviour
reason: Purkinje/granule layer formation, Bergmann glia, motor learning, locomotion and reflexes; the neural RNA-binding BTM is a minor outlier.
